_doc: Recurring design-intent → Velt-component mappings (the GENERAL shape, not design-specific CSS). The planner reads these as priors so it doesn't re-derive the same mapping every run. The exact cssDecls/values for a specific design remain project-scoped (target repo .velt-customize/memory.json), never here.

patterns.intent: comments sidebar surface (docked panel: header + scrollable list + composer)
patterns.note: The single wireframe registry root for a sidebar surface. Host mount: VeltCommentsSidebar with embedMode + pageMode + shadowDom={false}.

patterns.intent: page-mode comment composer (collapsed pill -> expanded with attach/mention/send)
patterns.note: Composer states: default collapsed pill, active (focused, toolbar), active-typing (send enabled). Attach + mention icons appear on focus/has-content.

patterns.intent: comment card / thread (avatar + author + body + reactions + reply)
patterns.note: KNOWN-HARD (see component-difficulty). Resists wireframe replacement; build minimal, cap fixes.

Supply the filter dropdown items explicitly. All sizes come from the design's spec nodes (never a remembered value). A filter-trigger set to inline stays at its glyph size — the trigger needs inline-flex + explicit w/h for its design box to apply.

patterns.intent: comment thread connector line (vertical line in the avatar gutter linking a comment to its replies)
patterns.wireframe: own-markup span inside ThreadCard (no Velt slot exists for it)
patterns.note: Draw as own markup, absolutely positioned inside the SDK's .velt-thread-card--container (set it position:relative), 1px wide at the avatar's center column, from below the avatar through the inter-comment gap; hidden on the last comment. See sdk-gotchas own-markup-decoration-needs-explicit-box.

patterns.intent: single Reply affordance per thread/annotation (design shows ONE Reply at the card bottom)
patterns.note: VERIFIED SDK RENDER FACT: ThreadCard.Reply renders PER COMMENT — mapping a once-per-annotation Reply to it duplicates the affordance on every comment. The once-per-annotation Reply is the Body-level ToggleReply slot. Two independent planner runs split on this (one chose each); the wrong choice only surfaces as duplicate Replies at build time — treat this mapping as a fixed prior, never re-derive it from slot names.

patterns.intent: composer send button glyph (any design that draws a send arrow)
patterns.note: NEVER leave the send glyph to the Velt default on the assumption it matches — the default does NOT match drawn send arrows (verified). ActionButton is an OVERWRITE slot (children get replaced; injecting markup can kill submit) — supply the design's exported SVG via CSS mask/background on the slot's stable class, planned as a style rule, with the asset file named in the plan.
